text:
rachel: Heads-up: customer hit runtime errors when loading our JS SDK in Cloudflare Pages worker. Bundle size doubled after adding fast-webcrypto.

tom: Yep. Pages + Workers runtimes have global crypto but different shapes (no subtle in older runtime?). Also btoa/atob sometimes missing depending on environment.

priya: Repro notes:
- Using SDK pkg @redwood/inference
- Bundled with vite -> target es2020 -> still pulls node-libs like events/process via some deps
- Error: ReferenceError: globalThis.process is not defined in CF Pages

lin: Minimal fix I used locally: set package.json exports so consumers pick `./dist/esm-edge/index.mjs` for browsers/edge. Also built a tiny shim module edge-shims.mjs that only defines missing bits.

```
// edge-shims.mjs
if (typeof globalThis.crypto === 'undefined') {
  globalThis.crypto = { subtle: { digest: async () => new Uint8Array(32) } }
}
if (typeof globalThis.btoa === 'undefined') {
  globalThis.btoa = s => Buffer.from(s, 'utf8').toString('base64')
}
```

rachel: Buffer will break on Workers (Buffer is Node). Avoid Buffer in edge-shim, use base64 encoder that uses globalThis.TextEncoder + atob polyfill.

priya: Important: our TS types reference NodeJS.Timer and `stream.Readable` in retry helpers. For customers with `lib: ['webworker']` tsc fails. We should ship separate d.ts for the edge export (conditional types via package.exports -> types).

tom: Also witnessed Vite/Rollup injecting process.env.NODE_ENV when bundling; that caused dependency graph to pull in process-polyfill. We should mark `browser: {"./dist/node.js": false}` and ensure rollup config uses replace plugin carefully.

lin: Proposal summary:
- Add an explicit `exports` map in package.json with a `./dist/esm-edge/` entry that points to a small ESM build without Node imports.
- Build flags: tsup/rollup target: platform: 'browser', external: ['crypto','fs','child_process'], treeshake node-specific helpers.
- Provide tiny opt-in edge-shims that are safe (no Buffer, no heavy ponyfills). Document them as opt-in.

rachel: Also add sample app `examples/workers-pages/minimal.mjs` demonstrating recommended bundler config and a miniflare test. Keep sample short and copy-pasteable.

priya: Tests: add e2e smoke using wrangler or miniflare in CI matrix (node/browser). Tagging build-bot to queue workers-e2e.

build-bot: ci: queued pipeline workers-pages-smoke #5721

tom: One last note: auth token rotation. Edge build must not include node-only jwt libs. Provide a lightweight fetch-based token refresh helper that hits our token endpoint and avoid dependencies on `jsonwebtoken` in edge bundle.

lin: I'll draft PR for package.exports + ts defs + example. Priya can handle d.ts split. Rachel will update onboarding docs to call out edge integration guidance.

rachel: Sounds good. Quick follow-ups: lint the edge build for no Node globals, and run minified bundle check to keep size < 10KB for minimal use-case. :rocket:
